items.label: {C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}{C3}
items.why: Deleted directory decoration. The records start at the BAM sector 18/0 and carry the directory bytes instead of a separate file chain.

items.label: LIVE AND LET DIE
items.why: Autostart runs the Fantasy intro and transfers control to its loader at $4400.

items.label: PIC
items.why: Separate 10240-byte title picture with the game logo and speedboat visible when the bitmap plane is rendered. The first post-intro LOAD in the traced boot was PHASE1.

items.label: PHASE2
items.why: Loader copies the $5000 staging image under I/O at $4481. All 4096 bytes agree at hand-over.

items.label: PHASE4
items.why: LOAD at $44CC overwrites $8000–$8FFF. All 4096 bytes agree at hand-over.

items.label: PHASE1
items.why: Loader copies the $5000 staging image to $E000–$FFFF at $4439. All 8192 bytes agree at hand-over.

items.label: PHASE5
items.why: LOAD at $44EE supplies the entry at $0803. All 15360 bytes agree at hand-over.

items.label: PHASE3
items.why: LOAD at $44B2. Every byte outside $8000–$8FFF agrees at hand-over. The loader immediately replaces that window with PHASE4.
